summary: Completed testing of Financeiro month/year filters feature. All backend API tests (11/11) and frontend UI tests passed successfully. The filters correctly filter receitas and despesas by month and year, summary cards update accordingly, and patrocinadores are not affected by date filters.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Financeiro filters feature fully tested and working. Backend endpoints /api/recebimentos and /api/despesas accept ?mes=X&ano=Y query params. Frontend has data-testid attributes: financeiro-month-filter, financeiro-year-filter. Test data: 9 recebimentos in 2024 (8 in June, 1 in December), 1 despesa in 2026-03-31.
